description: This source file implements the CyclerOld class, which extends a basic battery cycling class to perform various battery check-up procedures such as measuring OCV curves, performing capacity checks, CCCV cycles, and pulse tests. It contains methods for simulating and recording battery behavior, generating OCV curves, and writing data to CSV files for analysis.

classes.name: CyclerOld
classes.description: A class for simulating battery cycling procedures, including measurement and check-up routines for battery health diagnostics.

methods.name: getOCV
methods.description: Calculates the half-cell open circuit voltage (OCV) curves by fully cycling each electrode and aligning the curves on a common discharged charge axis.

methods.name: checkUp_batteryStates
methods.description: Performs a capacity check and records battery state data into a CSV file as part of a maintenance check-up.

methods.name: checkUp_OCVcurves
methods.description: Measures and records the half-cell OCV curves during a check-up, saving the data into a CSV file.

methods.name: checkUp_CCCV
methods.description: Simulates and records CCCV cycling procedures during a check-up, saving voltage, temperature, and cycling data.

methods.name: checkUp_pulse
methods.description: Performs a pulse test to evaluate battery response, recording voltage, temperature, and cycling data.
